verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs present CI/CD as a first-party part of the platform ('Get started with GitLab CI/CD', 'From planning to source control to CI/CD', compliance and SAST 'in every pipeline'). The Pulumi integration describes GitLab CI acting on commits to specific branches, which implies push-triggered runs. A community user calls the CI 'truly great' but reports reliability problems with CI workers not running; that affects confidence, not whether the capability exists. missing for 10: first-party evidence that pipelines are defined as a config file in the repository, first-party evidence of automatic triggering on pushes and merge requests (only partner integrations show this), and in-depth pipeline configuration docs.
